title: Application loads successfully
objective: Verify the SecureBank login page is served and renders.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL.
steps: Send an HTTP GET to BASE_URL/bank/login.
expected_result: HTTP status is 200 and the page title is "Sign in | SecureBank" (contains "SecureBank").
notes: Status code checked with requests; title checked in Chrome.

title: Login page UI elements present
objective: Verify the login form controls are usable.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session).
steps: Locate the username field, password field and login button.
Check each is visible and enabled.
expected_result: Username (#username), password (#password, masked) and login button (#login-button) are visible and enabled; the create-account link is shown.

title: Invalid URL shows Page not found
objective: Verify unknown routes return a proper 404 page.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL.
steps: Send an HTTP GET to BASE_URL/bank/invalid.
expected_result: HTTP status is 404; the page shows the heading "Page not found" and the title "Page not found | SecureBank".

title: Create account with valid details
objective: Verify a new customer can register and gets a funded checking account.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session).
test_data: Full name: Rahul Kumar; Email: rahul.demo1@test.com; Password: Test@123; Initial deposit: 1000
steps: Enter the full name, email, password and initial deposit.
Note the new account number from the confirmation.
expected_result: "Account created successfully" confirmation with a 10-digit account number and balance $1,000.00; the user is logged in and /bank/accounts lists the new "Everyday Checking" account with balance $1,000.00 (data-cents 100000).
notes: The hackathon brief reused ID SB-OP-01 for this case; renumbered SB-AC-01.

title: Mandatory field validation
objective: Verify all registration fields are required.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session).
expected_result: Errors shown: "Full name is required.", "Email is required.", "Password is required.", "Initial deposit is required."; no account is created.

title: Invalid email format
objective: Verify registration rejects a malformed email.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session).
test_data: Full name: Rahul Kumar; Email: rahul@invalid; Password: Test@123; Initial deposit: 1000
steps: Fill the form using the invalid email.
expected_result: Email error "Enter a valid email address." is shown; no account is created.

title: Weak password rejected
objective: Verify the password policy is enforced on registration.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session).
test_data: Full name: Rahul Kumar; Email: rahul.demo1@test.com; Password: 123; Initial deposit: 1000
steps: Fill the form using the weak password.
expected_result: Password error "Password must be at least 8 characters." is shown; no account is created.

title: Duplicate account rejected
objective: Verify one email cannot be registered twice.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session).
test_data: Full name: Rahul Kumar; Email: rahul.demo1@test.com; Password: Test@123; Initial deposit: 1000 (used twice)
steps: Open BASE_URL/bank/register and submit the same details again.
expected_result: Email error "An account already exists with this email." is shown; no second account is created.

title: Successful money transfer
objective: Verify a transfer moves money exactly between two customers.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session). Acc-A and Acc-B are created in the test through registration, each with $5,000.00.
steps: Register Acc-A and Acc-B (initial deposit 5000 each), logging out after each.
Log in as Acc-A and open BASE_URL/bank/transfer.
Select Acc-A as the from-account and check the available balance.
Enter Acc-B's account number and amount 500; submit.
Check the receipt and Acc-A's balance on /bank/accounts.
Log out, log in as Acc-B and check Acc-B's balance on /bank/accounts.
expected_result: "Transfer successful" with a reference; Acc-A = $4,500.00 (data-cents 450000); Acc-B = $5,500.00 (data-cents 550000); combined total stays $10,000.00.
notes: Balances verified via data-cents attributes as well as the displayed text.

title: Insufficient balance
objective: Verify a transfer larger than the available balance is rejected.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session). Acc-A is created through registration with $500.00 and stays logged in.
steps: Select Acc-A, enter recipient 1002003001 and amount 1000; submit.
expected_result: Amount error "Insufficient balance."; no transfer happens; Acc-A balance remains $500.00 (available balance and /bank/accounts).

title: Invalid recipient account
objective: Verify transfers to unknown accounts are rejected.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session). User is logged in as standard_user.
steps: Select 1002003001, enter recipient Acc-XYZ and amount 100; submit.
expected_result: Recipient error "Recipient account not found." for both; no transfer happens; 1002003001 balance stays $12,450.00.

title: Zero amount rejected
objective: Verify a zero amount cannot be transferred.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session). User is logged in as standard_user.
steps: Select 1002003001, enter recipient 1002003002 and amount 0; submit.
expected_result: Amount error "Amount must be greater than zero."; no transfer happens.

title: Negative amount rejected
objective: Verify a negative amount cannot be transferred.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session). User is logged in as standard_user.
steps: Select 1002003001, enter recipient 1002003002 and amount -100; submit.
expected_result: Amount error "Enter a valid amount."; no transfer happens.

title: Mandatory transfer fields blank
objective: Verify from-account, recipient and amount are required.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session). User is logged in as standard_user.
steps: Leave from-account unselected and recipient/amount empty.
expected_result: Errors shown: "Select the account to transfer from.", "Recipient account number is required.", "Amount is required."; no transfer happens.

title: Transaction history updated after transfer
objective: Verify a transfer is recorded for both sender and recipient.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session). Acc-A and Acc-B are created through registration with $5,000.00 each.
steps: Transfer 500 from Acc-A to Acc-B and note the reference.
Open BASE_URL/bank/transactions as Acc-A and read the newest row.
Log out, log in as Acc-B, open BASE_URL/bank/transactions and read the newest row.
expected_result: Acc-A's newest row: the transfer reference, description "Transfer to <Acc-B number>", category Transfer, amount -$500.00 (data-cents -50000). Acc-B's newest row: same reference, "Transfer from <Acc-A number>", amount +$500.00 (data-cents 50000).

title: Frozen account transfer rejected
objective: Verify customers with frozen accounts cannot move money.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session). User is logged in as frozen_user / bank_sauce.
steps: Open BASE_URL/bank/transfer and check the frozen notice.
Select 1002005001, enter recipient 1002003001 and amount 100; submit.
expected_result: Frozen notice is shown; form error "Your accounts are frozen. Transfers are disabled — please contact support."; balance stays $5,400.00.

title: Valid login
objective: Verify a customer can log in with valid credentials.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session).
expected_result: Redirected to /bank/dashboard (title "Dashboard | SecureBank") showing "Welcome back, Alex", username standard_user and "Across 2 accounts".

title: Invalid password rejected
objective: Verify a wrong password does not authenticate.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session).
steps: Enter standard_user and a wrong password.
expected_result: Error "Invalid username or password."; the user stays on the login page.

title: Locked user rejected
objective: Verify locked customers cannot log in.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session).
expected_result: Error "Your account has been locked. Please contact support."; the user stays on the login page.

title: Slow user dashboard loads
objective: Verify the dashboard loads for a slow-loading account using explicit waits.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session).
steps: Open BASE_URL/bank/login and log in as slow_user.
Wait for the page loader (#page-loader) to disappear.
expected_result: After the ~2.5 s loader disappears, the dashboard shows "Welcome back, Taylor", username slow_user and "Across 2 accounts".
notes: Uses explicit waits only (no fixed sleeps).

title: Logout shows confirmation
objective: Verify a customer can log out.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session). User is logged in as standard_user.
expected_result: Redirected to /bank/login?reason=logged_out showing "You have been logged out."

title: Protected page blocked after logout
objective: Verify the session is destroyed on logout.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session). User is logged in as standard_user.
expected_result: Redirected to /bank/login?reason=auth showing "Please sign in to continue."; dashboard content is not shown.

title: Update profile with valid data
objective: Verify a customer can update and persist profile details.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session). User is logged in as standard_user.
test_data: Full name: Alexandra Morgan-Reed; Email: alex.updated.<run>@test.com; Phone: 5550198765; Address: 221B Baker Street, Springfield
steps: Replace full name, email, phone and address.
expected_result: "Profile updated successfully."; the sidebar name changes to the new full name; all values persist after reload; the username is unchanged.

title: Profile invalid email rejected
objective: Verify the profile rejects a malformed email.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session). User is logged in as standard_user.
expected_result: Email error "Enter a valid email address."; no success message; the stored email remains alex.morgan@example.com.

title: Profile required fields blank
objective: Verify required profile fields are enforced.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session). User is logged in as standard_user.
test_data: Full name, email and phone cleared
steps: Clear full name, email and phone.
expected_result: Errors shown: "Full name is required.", "Email is required.", "Phone number is required."; nothing is saved.

title: Change password end to end
objective: Verify a password change takes effect for subsequent logins.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session). User is logged in as standard_user.
steps: Enter current, new and confirm passwords; submit.
Try to log in with the old password.
Log in with the new password.
expected_result: "Password changed successfully." and the fields are cleared; the old password is rejected with "Invalid username or password."; the new password logs in to the dashboard.

title: Wrong current password
objective: Verify the current password must be correct.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session). User is logged in as standard_user.
steps: Enter a wrong current password and a valid new password; submit.
expected_result: Error "Current password is incorrect."; the password is not changed.

title: Password confirmation mismatch
objective: Verify new password and confirmation must match.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session). User is logged in as standard_user.
test_data: Current: bank_sauce; New: NewSauce2026; Confirm: NewSauce2027
expected_result: Error "Passwords do not match."; the password is not changed.

title: Weak new password rejected
objective: Verify the password policy applies to password changes.
preconditions: SecureBank is running at BASE_URL; fresh browser profile (seeded demo data, no session). User is logged in as standard_user.
steps: Log out and log in with the original password.
expected_result: Error "Password must be at least 8 characters."; the original password still logs in.
